nodes.label: WWDC 2020: The Details of UI Typography
nodes.norm_label: wwdc 2020: the details of ui typography

nodes.label: Direct Manipulation (1:1 Tracking)
nodes.rationale: Touch and content move together respecting grab offset without snapping to center using Pointer Events and pointer capture

nodes.label: Interruptibility Principle
nodes.rationale: Thought and gesture happen in parallel; every animation must be interruptible and redirectable mid-flight from current presentation value

nodes.label: Materials and Depth (Translucency)
nodes.rationale: Translucent backdrop blur conveys hierarchy and depth without stealing focus; material weight encodes importance

nodes.label: Momentum Projection
nodes.rationale: Projects resting endpoints using exponential decay based on release velocity before snapping to the nearest target

nodes.label: Multimodal Feedback (Audio-Haptics)
nodes.rationale: Synchronize visual, sound, and haptic feedback on the exact same frame, anchored by causality and utility

nodes.label: Reduced Motion & Accessibility
nodes.rationale: Provide non-vestibular equivalents like cross-fades and solid backgrounds responding to prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-reduced-transparency, and prefers-contrast

nodes.label: Response (Zero Latency)
nodes.rationale: The moment lag appears directness falls off a cliff; feedback must be instant on pointer-down and continuous during interaction

nodes.label: Rubber-banding Soft Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Progressive resistance past boundaries instead of hard stopping, communicating limits while preserving responsiveness

nodes.label: Spatial Consistency
nodes.rationale: Maintain symmetric paths for enter and exit, mirror easing curves on reversible transitions, and anchor transformations to triggering origins

nodes.label: Spring Physics (Behavior Over Animation)
nodes.rationale: Replaces fixed-duration scripting with dynamic springs parameterized by damping ratio and response so motion continuously adapts to input

nodes.label: UI Typography Foundations
nodes.rationale: Optical sizing, size-specific negative tracking for display text, inverse leading, and dynamic type hierarchy

nodes.label: Velocity Handoff
nodes.rationale: Continuously inject gesture release velocity as spring initial velocity to eliminate seams between drag and animation

nodes.label: Apple System Design Typography & Theme
nodes.rationale: Adopts Apple-style background palette (#F5F5F7), text (#1D1D1F), optimizeLegibility, and font-feature-settings cv02, cv03, cv04, cv11
